title: Reframe admin presets as library, preview, and diagnostics
description: Adjust the Filter Preset admin surface so it reflects saved widget presets, previews their structure, and reports health without becoming the primary builder.
objective: Make wp-admin answer what presets exist, where they came from, whether they are healthy, and how they can be reused or recovered.
expected_outputs: Preset library metadata table or list
Diagnostics for missing target, empty options, unsupported fields, unknown types, and unverified selectors
Preserved rename, duplicate, delete, and recovery flows
acceptance_criteria: Admin does not present itself as the required filter builder.
Saved widget presets are visible with name, key, source, filter count, selectors, and updated date.
Preview uses the same normalized data loaded by the widget.
Diagnostics reveal obvious preset health issues.
Destructive actions remain nonce and capability protected.
verification: JS syntax check passes for assets/js/eit-admin.js if touched.
WP-CLI smoke creates a preset and confirms it appears in admin data.
Browser/simple screenshot check may be used for gross admin rendering only.
Guilherme remains final QA for nuanced admin visual judgment.

budgets.context_budget: admin preset UI, admin renderer, preset support
budgets.validation_budget: syntax plus WP-CLI smoke plus simple browser check

risks: Admin can drift back into a second builder if too much composition UI is added.
Preview can become expensive if it requires full Elementor rendering too early.
